insight.zh: 核心构图不是单纯“仿真图变漂亮”，而是把可控输入、生成外观与保持不变的几何/动作关系明确对应。
insight.en: The key composition aligns controllable simulation inputs, generated appearance, and the geometry/action information that should remain consistent.

zh: 左侧展示仿真深度/机器人掩码等条件；右侧展示生成的 RGB 视频效果。
比较面板应共享任务、相机视角、对象或时刻，避免制造不公平对照。
少量标注区分生成的画面与真正拍摄的真实实验。
en: Contrast simulation depth and robot-mask conditions with generated RGB outcomes.
Align tasks, camera views, objects and time across comparison panels.
Clearly label generated imagery rather than passing it off as captured real-world results.

zh: 先固定真实论文要表达的唯一视觉主张。
选同一场景与同一时刻的输入、生成、真实参考（若有授权）三类证据。
按比较维度排列面板，caption 明确哪些是生成、哪些是实测。
en: State the one comparison your paper can actually support.
Choose matched input, generated and licensed real-reference conditions.
Align panels and distinguish synthetic and physical measurements in labels and captions.

zh: 不得从图片好看直接推导策略成功率，需要独立的实验结果。
展示外部论文画面前需图像级授权；此图为本站原创分析示意。
en: Image quality alone does not establish policy success; use separate results.
Figure-level rights must be verified before embedding external paper imagery.

video demo
multi-view

zh: 需要制作展示视觉变换的研究主页
en: Building a project page for visual transformation results

zh: 以直接对比展示方法价值
把主要演示放在简介附近
en: Show value through direct contrasts
Keep primary demos near the main claim

zh: 不要仅参考视觉设计而忽略科学解释
en: Do not copy presentation without validating scientific context

insight.zh: 先用直观的视觉变化解释方法，再让用户沿多视角视频与真实机器人任务结果逐步核实。
insight.en: Lead with an immediately visible transformation, then let readers inspect multi-view video consistency and robot-task evidence.

zh: Hero 区承载一句清晰价值主张而非大段摘要。
模拟输入、生成视频、真实下游结果是不同证据层级，应分区域展示。
外部视角与腕部视角最好并排且时序同步，以便观察一致性。
en: Use a claim-first hero instead of an abstract dump.
Separate input/output demonstrations from downstream real-world task outcomes.
Place external/wrist camera views side by side and keep temporal comparisons consistent.

zh: 先列核心主张与一个最有说服力的演示。
组织“主张 → 成对视觉对比 → 多视角 demo → 实验表格”的阅读顺序。
为真实实验设置和数据提供可追溯论文入口。
en: Open with a verifiable central claim and strongest example.
Build a claim → paired results → multi-view demo → experiment-evidence sequence.
Link each real-world result to experimental setup and paper sources.

zh: 不能把生成视频称为真实机器人拍摄。
站内展示的是主页信息架构拆解，不是官网截图。
en: Generated video is not the same as real robot footage.
The site preview is an authored information-architecture study, not the source screenshot.

区分真实与仿真证据

Differentiate simulated versus physical demonstrations

insight.zh: 评测型工作最重要的是让读者迅速知道评了什么、在什么条件下评、为何仿真与现实共同必要。
insight.en: A benchmark overview should answer what is tested, under which conditions, and why simulated and physical evaluations complement one another.

zh: 将 42 项仿真任务与 18 项真实任务分为两个清楚的视觉区。
先体现任务多样性，再说明泛化、记忆、精度、长时程与开放指令这五个维度。
机器人、任务和环境的对应关系要明确，不要只堆满场景小图。
en: Keep 42 simulation tasks and 18 real-world tasks in visibly distinct groups.
Show task diversity before listing generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon and open instruction following.
Use unambiguous robot-task-environment labels, not an unlabeled image collage.

zh: 定义评估维度与仿真/真实范围。
每个任务组选取具有代表性的真实素材，并注明平台与条件。
使用统计汇总说明覆盖面，不能将任务数量当成性能分数。
en: Define axes and simulation/real evaluation scope.
Choose representative, licensed visuals and label the platform and setup.
Summarize coverage accurately; task counts are not performance scores.

zh: 42/18 为官网描述的任务数量，不能推断每项任务难度相等。
官网外链媒体图片不能从代码仓库的 MIT 许可自动推断授权。
en: The 42/18 figures refer to official task counts, not matched task difficulty.
An MIT license on a software repo does not automatically license externally hosted imagery.

description.zh: 参考任务画廊、真实演示与项目叙事的组织，帮助大量实验内容保持可读。

视频与文字介绍建立一一对应
en: Organize demos by task or embodiment
Tie captions directly to demos

zh: 不要把项目主页截图视作开放许可

insight.zh: 项目主页的价值来自“任务发现 → 演示观察 → 实验协议 → 排名/证据”，而不是单纯堆视频。
insight.en: The project site creates value through task discovery, demonstrations, evaluation protocol and evidence, rather than a wall of videos.

zh: 主页突出任务规模，给初次访问者明确研究范围。
任务画廊、真实环境评估与 leaderboard 分层组织。
排行榜之外应该能找到协议、版本、复现实验入口。
en: Lead with evaluation scope to orient first-time visitors.
Separate task galleries, real-world evaluation and leaderboard results.
Keep protocol, version and reproducibility routes visible next to rankings.

zh: 围绕访问者最重要的三个问题建立导航：评什么、怎么评、结果在哪。
为任务建立可筛选索引，不使用无法理解的无标签视频列表。
在 leaderboard 周围明确指标含义与版本/协议。
en: Design navigation around what, how, and evidence.
Use filterable task groups rather than unlabeled video thumbnails.
Explain leaderboard metrics and their evaluation protocol/version.

zh: 静态封面不等于可操作演示；交互效果需要在实际网站测试。
排名结果随提交变化，使用时核对官方日期与协议。
en: A cover is not a functioning demo; verify the actual website interaction.
Leaderboard standings evolve; check official dates and protocols.

把视觉冲击力和明确的实验设置、数值证据放在一起

Pair compelling visual evidence with explicit numeric comparisons and experimental conditions

insight.zh: 将可视化的 world-model motion rollout 与可量化的训练投入并列，让“方法机制”与“价值主张”同时进入视野。
insight.en: Juxtapose a visible world-model motion rollout with quantitative compute context, connecting mechanism and claimed value.

zh: 左边以不同时间的人形姿态轨迹示意动态过程，而不是多个不同机器人。
右边显示 1 H100、3 小时与 SONIC 128 L40、7 天的官方训练配置对照。
硬件型号和训练口径与对比结论必须始终同屏标注。
en: Depict time-separated motion poses rather than multiple distinct robots.
Show the officially reported 1 H100/3 h and SONIC 128 L40/7 day settings.
Retain device models and measurement boundaries alongside any claim.

zh: 把机制与核心实验价值各压缩成一个面板。
用符合数据的轨迹、截图或图表显示方法，并标注时间关系。
仅在实验方法可核对时展示资源对照，不凭异构 GPU 计算绝对效率倍数。
en: Give mechanism and core measured value one panel each.
Use evidence-faithful motion imagery and clear time labels.
Only compare compute figures with documented conditions; avoid hardware-normalized claims without data.

zh: 不同 GPU 型号下的耗时与 GPU-hours 不等于严格等价硬件的消融。
主页标题与论文 Figure 1 是两类资产；此图为原创内容拆解。
en: Cross-GPU wall clock and GPU-hours are not controlled same-hardware ablations.
The homepage hero is not paper Figure 1; this is an authored deconstruction.

description.zh: 冷白、黑色大标题、宽松留白与分段证据；主页的视觉节奏服务于科研论证。

控制页面节奏和信息密度
用研究视频而非装饰图主导视觉
en: Follow claims with evidence
Use pacing and whitespace intentionally
Prioritize research demos over decoration

zh: 不要照搬原站图片和代码
不要将审美判断当作研究指标
en: Do not copy original site artwork or code

insight.zh: 极简标题负责建立问题意识，定量对比、交互 demo 和真实部署证据负责让主张可信。
insight.en: A strong, restrained headline creates attention; quantified evidence, demos and physical deployment make it credible.

zh: 首屏使用有力但简短的主张“Compute is no longer the bottleneck”。
下一段立即给出 1 GPU/3 h 与 SONIC 配置的数字对照及归一化回报指标。
之后依次展开交互 demo、方法流程、模拟对照、真实 G1 部署与参考资料。
en: The hero leads with the short claim 'Compute is no longer the bottleneck'.
Follow immediately with compute settings and normalized-return comparisons.
Continue with interactive demo, method, simulation comparisons, physical G1 evidence and sources.

zh: 先用一句可证伪的话说清方法解决的主要限制。
把支持该句的一个核心指标放在下一屏，而非堆满特点列表。
按“主张—核心证据—机制—局限—复现”组织后续页面。
en: Open with one falsifiable proposition about the central bottleneck.
Place a directly supporting metric immediately after the hero.
Sequence claim, core evidence, mechanism, limitations and reproducibility.

zh: 不要借用官网的比较结果作为自己论文的证据。
横跨不同硬件的资源比较须注明训练和评测口径。
en: Do not transfer another paper's findings to your own work.
Cross-hardware comparisons need stated training and evaluation settings.
